newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp sets vote on General Mills merger.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp sets vote on General Mills merger.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc said Thursday it will hold a special shareholder meeting January 31 to vote on the proposed sale of its branded cereal and snack business to General Mills Inc and the spinoff of its private-label cereal and snack businesses.

Ralcorp confirmed the meeting date after the Federal Trade Commission said Thursday it would not oppose General Mills deal, valued at $570 million. Regulators were concernced about a provision in the agreement that would have blocked Ralcorp from marketing a private-label line of cereals and snacks similar to General Mills' CHEX brand within 18 months after the merger closes.
General Mills dropped the provision and the merger is now expected to close January 31, Ralcorp said.
Shares of Ralcorp, the nation's largest private-label cereal maker, were up 7/8 Thursday afternoon at 19-3/4.
